Subject: Quick check — trying Redwood (usage spike)

Hi Jordan,

We spun up Redwood last week for a small internal POC and noticed a big jump in token usage overnight (mostly embedding + reranking jobs). I reviewed the dashboard and wanted to see if we can do a short walkthrough — mainly to check cost controls, batching suggestions, and best practices for KV caching.

Is someone available this week for a quick intro? We're in SF (PST) — afternoons are best for me.

A couple of notes:
- Team: Samira (product), Luis (ML lead)
- Current plan: self-serve account, trial credits
- Spike was ~2.4x baseline between 2–3AM (we're guessing test infra) — attached a small usage snapshot.

Thanks,
Samira

Hi Samira — great to hear from you, and thanks for the screenshot.

Short answer: yes, we can run a focused 30-minute session to walk through what happened and give concrete suggestions (batching, prefix caching, and a quick review of your quantization/variant choices). I can do Thursday 11/6 10:00am or 3:00pm PST — if neither works I can drop a Calendly link.

I looped in Ben (SDR/technical handoff) — he'll join to cover quick runbook steps and follow up with a short mutual action plan. If you want a deeper infra dive, we can pull Marissa (Customer Success) for the onboarding + SLA discussion.

Proposed agenda (30 mins):
- 5m: quick context & goals
- 10m: runway review (billing, quotas, where tokens spiked)
- 10m: ops + config suggestions (batching, KV cache, autoscaling)
- 5m: immediate next steps + mutual action plan

I've attached a simple mutual action plan template we'll use to capture ownership. If you confirm a time I'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Best,
Jordan Blake
